titulo: Conjugate poner in the simple future
subtitulo: Poner swaps its e for a d: pondré, pondrás, pondremos.
regla: Poner replaces the e of its infinitive with d to make the stem pondr-, then adds -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -án.

bloques.texto: **Poner** (_to put_) is irregular in the **simple future** (**futuro imperfecto**). The endings are the normal ones; the stem is **pondr-**: the **e** of the infinitive turns into a **d**.
Verbs built on **poner** do the same: **componer** → **compondré**, **suponer** → **supondré**, **proponer** → **propondré**, **ponerse** → **me pondré**.
Tip: **poner**, **tener**, **venir**, **salir** and **valer** are the **d** gang: they all slip in a **d**: **pondré**, **tendré**, **vendré**, **saldré**, **valdré**.

lista.es: ==Pondré== la tabla en el carro esta noche.
lista.en: I'll put the board in the car tonight.

lista.es: ==Pondrás== las semillas en la tierra del huerto.
lista.en: You'll put the seeds in the soil of the garden.

lista.es: El cliente ==pondrá== la llave nueva en su llavero.
lista.en: The customer will put the new key on his key ring.

lista.es: ==Pondremos== el dinero para la carne asada.
lista.en: We'll put in the money for the carne asada.

lista.es: ==Pondrán== un cartel en la taquería para anunciar el torneo.
lista.en: They'll put up a poster in the taquería to announce the tournament.

lista.es: Mañana ==me pondré== el traje largo; el agua está fría.
lista.en: Tomorrow I'll put on the full wetsuit; the water is cold.

lista.texto: The endings are the same as for every verb in the future: [[5155|regular verbs in the simple future]].
In the present only **yo** is irregular: [[5305|poner in the present]].
The conditional uses the very same stem, with **-ía** endings: [[5892|the conditional]].
The future also guesses about right now: [[5060|the future for probability]].
The future of **haber** + participle: [[5066|irregular verbs in the future perfect]].

lista.p: **Poner**, **yo**: ___ la carne en el asador a las seis.
lista.r: Pondré la carne en el asador a las seis.
